Punjabi Fruit Chat
By: miansari66
Published: Wednesday, November 3, 2010 - 10:55pm

Ingredients




1 chopped apples 1 no
2 chopped banana 2- 3 no
3 chopped apricot ½
4 cups grapes rougly mashed 1
5 mashed orages 2 nos
6 cups pine apples cubes 1 with syrup
7 cups pomegrante seeds ½
1 cup 8 chopped guava
9 cups boiled kabli channa ½
10 cups youghurt mint raita ½
11 cups boiled and chopped potatoes ½
12 cups boiled sweet potato (shakar kandi) ½- 1
1 teaspoon 13 . Chat masala 2- 3 teaspoon (to make chat masala use salt

Preparation

1 Mix together all available fruits and other ingredients except youghurt raita and chat masala, which to be sprinkled on top. 2 Imli chutney (tamarind chutney), aaloo bukhara chutney (plum chutney) and lemon juice can also be added on top to enhance flavout and taste. 3 Chopped green chillies  (2-3) and chopped onion (1 small) can also be added

About


This is a very tasty, fruity and mouth watering snack from Company Bagh Faisalabd punjab.
